resolutions.researcher_notes: Possible other name for P0176, Dominion Gas Pipeline. A federal regulator order from January 2018 calls the 88-mile line that runs west from the Cove Point terminal in Maryland to Virginia the "Cove Point Pipeline". That matches the start of this row, which begins at Dominion LNG in Maryland. The order says the pipeline belongs to Dominion Energy Cove Point LNG, so check that this row covers that company's line and not only the Dominion Transmission lines. Accepting adds the name to the other English names cell and changes nothing else. The 2008 Cove Point expansion loop is queued separately. The other English names column has no reference column of its own, so the pages that use the name are added to the status reference cell, after the references already there. Pages that use the name "Cove Point Pipeline": https://www.ferc.gov/sites/default/files/2020-08/CP17-15.pdf. Check: The Cove Point Pipeline is owned by Dominion Energy Cove Point LNG, LP, not Dominion Gas Pipeline; check it is the same row.
